string.text: Automatic mode uses the engine's native no-wait loading path. On older Modded Exes builds where this path misses the loading-screen-dismissed callback, Load Ready supplies that callback once after precaching so GAMMA interaction systems can finish startup. No simulated keys or DLL are used.
Enable Load Ready audio and automatic entry. When disabled, the normal Press Any Key behavior is kept.
Select voice lines, PDA sound, radio, or your own Custom files. An empty pool falls back to the bundled short cue. Custom can play one random file or the entire folder once.
From 0 to 1. Does not change global game volume. Zero mutes the notification.
Voice mode only. Adds the requested trader_wait and meet_wait lines, including the exact greh_3, greh_1, freedom_3, ecolog_3, dolg_3, build_3 and bandit_4 selections.
Vano: pas_b400_vano_about_dome_1_pda has 100% priority on the very first load in voice mode. The marker is shared across saves; the line is never randomly selected again.
Choose a random one of five signals or a fixed signal. Enabled jokes are also added to this mode's pool.
Allow files inside _channel_1. The _channel_1_session folder is always excluded.
Allow files inside _channel_2. The _channel_2_session folder is always excluded.
Allow files inside _playlist_1. Other eligible radio files remain in the pool.
Radio tail after entering gameplay, seconds
How long radio may continue after loading is dismissed. Default: 5 seconds so auto-entry also has an audible cue. 0 stops radio on entry.
Maximum duration of a radio file, even while waiting for input. No repeat or looping.
_channel_1_session and _channel_2_session are always excluded. Plays a single file, not an entire folder.
Adds only joke_* files from human\...\talk\jokes to the selected pool. Woman voices, intro_joke_* and reaction_joke_* are excluded. A joke replaces the normal cue; it is not layered over it.
Off by default. One 1-in-100 roll per load: play blowout instead of the normal cue. Sound only, no real emission. Does not replace Vano's first greeting.
blowout searches for that exact filename in game resources. For another file use a path relative to sounds, such as ambient\my_sound. Do not use a C:\ path.
Detailed [R1-LOAD-READY] lines in the existing game log. Does not create a catalog report or a separate state file. The one-time greeting is remembered in the existing global game settings.
Legacy setting kept only so older saved MCM data remains readable. Version 1.4.0 no longer simulates keyboard input.

Random: one file per load, avoiding an immediate repeat when possible. All: every Custom OGG once, in alphabetical relative-path order, without overlap or looping. Name files 01_name.ogg, 02_name.ogg to set the order. Enabled jokes and screamer may replace the entire notification.

Off: let the Custom sound or playlist finish after entering the game. On: stop Custom and discard remaining tracks on actual dismissal. Does not delay automatic entry. Radio duration limits do not apply to Custom.

Folder: gamedata\sounds\r1_load_ready\custom\ . All .ogg files are discovered, including subfolders; README is ignored. OGG Vorbis, 44100 Hz, mono or stereo. Remove 00_example.ogg when adding your sounds. Restart the game after changing files. Opening the main menu, applying settings or reloading cancels the current Custom playlist.
